#
#   docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/repo:ro" \
#     python:3.12-slim@sha256:78387bc3881b8273120a12ebe6c1ab22b018ccc2c9adf565ae1ac9b536e184ea \
#     sh -c 'python -m pip install --quiet --no-cache-dir -r /repo/requirements.in && python -m pip freeze'
#
# The build decides the HTML that gets served, so it gets the same treatment as
# the server's runtime: every package exact, transitives included, nothing left
# for the resolver to pick by the calendar. Versions shared with
# `server/requirements.txt` are held equal, because CI installs both at once.
# `pip` itself is deliberately absent: the pinned base image already fixes the
# installer, and this file describes the build.
